title: Closure theorem in degree zero (CL(0), parent Part III)
statement: Assume (REP) (verbatim the first conjunct of sibling foundations: mass representation of currents with locally finite mass, with absolute continuity), (MR) M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every IMRep R of T (type of accepted cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure) and (IMC) (type of accepted cmc_imRep_locality_restrict_sub). For every P ∈ ℕ, open U ⊆ ℝ^P and T_j, T ∈ 𝒟_0(U): if every T_j is IM, sup_j(M_W(T_j) + boundaryMassOn(T_j, W)) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U (the boundary term is 0 in degree 0) and T_j ⇀ T, then T is IM. (Verbatim the type of the unaccepted DAG node cbr_closure_degree_zero.)

B)) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict R.carrier), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |R.orient x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α)) → ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U 0) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U 0), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + boundaryMassOn (Ts j) W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T
